device_name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti Laptop GPU
scope: One finite, local Ey dipole Maxwell field solve per measured catalog preset. Confirms grid translation, propagation and FDTDX CPU/GPU repeatability. Calibrated transmission, resonator Q, lasing, and commercial field agreement require independent physical references.
comparison: Same configuration except CPU/GPU, identical effective step count, time, source and every raw and display axis/permittivity array. Relative L2 = norm(GPU - CPU)/norm(CPU), float64 accumulation on signed float32 fields. Existing field integration limits are 1e-4 combined and 1e-3 per component.
digest_convention: SHA-256 of C-contiguous numeric array bytes, no filenames or metadata. Configuration SHA-256 is compact sorted-key JSON excluding the device field.
